name: Nigeria NBS — National Data Archive (microdata catalogue)
description: 107 NBS surveys and statistical publications. Each row: id, idno (NGA-NBS-…), title, subtitle, nation, authoring_entity, year_start/end, varcount, total_views, total_downloads, created/changed, catalogue url. Detail hop by idno returns the full DDI: producers with affiliation and role, version statement, study scope, sampling, and a variable list (1,229 variables on the APRM survey).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Nigeria NBS — data-citation register
description: Publications that cite NBS microdata. Row: id, uuid, title, subtitle, authors[] (fname/lname/author_type), editors, publisher, place_publication, volume, issue, edition, idnumber, url, page range, created/changed. Small (1 record today) but it is the author-to-dataset link.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CAPMAS Egypt statistical releases and news
description: 3,454 CAPMAS releases: id, Arabic title, brief, full HTML content, image, publishDate, isPdf and pdfUrl, publicationId, newsCategory, tags, plus a newsTranslation array carrying the English title/brief/content. Detail hop by numeric id returns the single record. The bulk list is ~9.6MB per fetch.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ANSD Senegal tender notices (JSON:API)
description: Senegal's national statistics agency tender notices as Drupal JSON:API nodes: uuid, attributes.title carrying the full reference (e.g. '03/2021/AON/ANSD/EHCVM - AVIS D'APPEL D'OFFRES'), body, created/changed dates, path alias and file relationships. Detail hop returns the single node with all fields and attachment relationships.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ANSD Senegal news items (JSON:API)
description: 47 ANSD news nodes with uuid, French title (e.g. 'Financement du RGPH5 : les bailleurs s'engagent'), body HTML, publication and change timestamps, and image relationships. Detail hop returns the full node.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ANSD Senegal laws and regulations (JSON:API)
description: 28 Senegalese statistical-system legal instruments (laws, decrees, national strategies such as the Strategie Nationale de Developpement de la Statistique) with uuid, title, body, dates and attached document files. Detail hop returns the node plus file relationships.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ANSD Senegal surveys and studies (JSON:API)
description: 46 ANSD survey/study nodes (e.g. 'Enquete harmonisee sur les Conditions de Vie des Menages') with uuid, title, description, dates and a field_lien_acces_donnees link object pointing at the microdata access page. Detail hop returns the node.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ANSD Senegal economic indicators (JSON:API)
description: Senegalese headline economic indicator nodes (e.g. 'PIB (trimestriel) a prix constant CVS') with uuid, title and an embedded field_don chart configuration carrying the actual series data collector tables. Detail hop returns the node with the full series payload.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ANSD Senegal economic and social situation reports (JSON:API)
description: 50 chapters of Senegal's annual Situation Economique et Sociale with uuid, title, body and attached PDF relationships - the standing reference series on the Senegalese economy.

name: ANSD Senegal statistical flash bulletins (JSON:API)
description: 50 monthly flash bulletins with uuid and dated titles carrying the headline result itself (e.g. 'Legere hausse du niveau general des prix - novembre'), body text and attached PDFs. The fastest-moving ANSD series.

name: ANSD Senegal annual activity reports (JSON:API)
description: 19 ANSD annual activity reports (through 'Rapport annuel d'activite 2025') with uuid, title, publication dates and attached report files.

name: ANSD Senegal census reports (JSON:API)
description: Senegalese population census report nodes (RGP76 onwards) with uuid, title, description and attached census volumes.

name: ANSD Senegal methodological resources (JSON:API)
description: ANSD methodological guides (e.g. 'Guide Pratique de Projections Demographiques') with uuid, title, body and attached documents.

name: ANSD Senegal events (JSON:API)
description: ANSD event nodes (e.g. 'Lancement cartographie pilote du RGPH-5') with uuid, title, event dates and body - useful for tracking the Senegalese census operation calendar.

name: ANSD Senegal recruitment competitions (JSON:API)
description: Public recruitment/competition notices issued by ANSD (e.g. 'Avis de concours pour le recrutement d'eleves Ingenieurs') with uuid, title, body and deadline dates.

name: ANSD Senegal administrative procedures (JSON:API)
description: 7 procedure nodes describing how to obtain ANSD services/certifications (e.g. 'Profession liberal') with uuid, title and step-by-step body text.

name: ANSD Senegal statistical theme tree (JSON:API)
description: The ANSD themes/sub-themes definition node with uuid, title and the embedded taxonomy used to address every other Senegalese statistical series. Small but it is the join key for the rest.

name: ONS Algeria - Office National des Statistiques feed
description: Algeria's national statistics office SPIP backend feed - the only open machine-readable Algerian government source I could verify. Items include the consumer price index bulletin for Algiers and public consultations (e.g. 'Consultation relative au renouvellement des licences'), each with title, link, description and dc:date.

name: PNCP - detalhe da contratacao por orgao/ano/sequencial
description: Second hop behind a tender row: full record for one contratacao - estimated vs homologated value, secrecy code, modality and dispute mode, legal basis text, buying body CNPJ/razaoSocial, unit, sub-rogated body, links to the origin system and the electronic process.

name: Camara dos Deputados - ficha do deputado
description: Detail hop behind the (already-collected) deputy list: civil name, electoral name, party and UF, legislature, photo URL, e-mail, office (gabinete) building/room/phone, CPF-adjacent biographical fields, birth date and birthplace.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Camara - frentes parlamentares de um deputado
description: Every parliamentary front (lobby caucus) a deputy belongs to - 227 for a single member - with front id, title and legislature. The cleanest keyless map of Brazilian legislative interest groups. Auto-labels on 'titulo'.

name: Camara - profissoes declaradas de um deputado
description: Self-declared professions of a deputy with the declaration timestamp and profession type code. Auto-labels on 'titulo'.

name: Camara - historico de status de um deputado
description: Party-switching and mandate history: one row per change with name, electoral name, party at that moment, UF, legislature number, timestamp, situation (Exercicio/Licenca/Vacancia), electoral condition (Titular/Suplente) and a prose description of what changed. Auto-labels on 'nome'.

name: Camara - detalhe de uma proposicao
description: Detail hop behind the proposition list: type/number/year, full ementa, presentation timestamp, and the statusProposicao block - current organ, last rapporteur URI, regime, tramitation description, situation, despacho text, scope and appreciation type.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Camara - autores de uma proposicao
description: Who actually filed a bill: author name, a deputy URI that resolves to the full member record, author type (Deputado/Orgao/Senador), signature order and a proponent flag. Auto-labels on 'nome'.

name: Camara - tramitacoes de uma proposicao
description: Docket entries behind a bill: timestamp, sequence number, acting organ (sigla + URI), rapporteur URI, regime, tramitation type and code, situation and code, and the full despacho text of each procedural act.

name: Camara - membros de um orgao/comissao
description: Who sits on a committee: deputy id and URI, name, party, UF, legislature, e-mail, photo, plus the role held (titulo/codTitulo - Presidente, Vice) with start and end dates. Officer-behind-the-body hop. Auto-labels on 'nome'.

name: Camara - eventos de um orgao/comissao
description: Sittings held by a committee: event id, start/end timestamps, situation, event type, agenda description, the organs involved (with sigla, full name, type), physical room, and the YouTube recording URL.

name: Camara - membros de um partido
description: Current bench of a party: deputy id and URI, name, party sigla, UF, legislature, photo URL and institutional e-mail. Auto-labels on 'nome'.

name: Camara - deputados presentes num evento
description: Attendance list for a specific sitting: each deputy's id, URI, name, party, UF, legislature, photo and e-mail - i.e. who was in the room. Auto-labels on 'nome'.

name: Camara - membros de um grupo parlamentar de amizade
description: Bilateral friendship group (e.g. Brasil/Armenia) with its id and name, carrying a membros[] array of 33 deputies each with name, deputy URI, role (Presidente, 1o Vice-Presidente), legislature and start/end dates. Set array_path 'dados' - auto-detection would otherwise pick the inner membros array.

name: Senado Federal - processos legislativos (API nova)
description: The replacement Senate API (the old materia/pesquisa service is deprecated). Flat top-level array: id, codigoMateria, identificacao (e.g. 'PL 1/2025'), full ementa, the complete authorship string naming every co-signing senator with party and state, presentation/deliberation/situation dates, current situation, deliberation outcome and the resulting law number. Has both 'id' and 'ementa'.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Senado Federal - detalhe de um processo
description: 23kB detail hop behind each Senate process: identification, type, the conteudo block (norm type, ementa, indicated norm), the documento block (document id, type, text URLs) and the full tramitation/authorship structure.

name: NSE India - corporate announcements (equities)
description: Live regulated-disclosure stream for every NSE-listed Indian company. Per filing: sm_name (company legal name), sm_isin, symbol, smIndustry, an_dt and exchdisstime (filing vs dissemination time), desc (disclosure category), attchmntText (full narrative of what was disclosed) and attchmntFile (direct PDF URL), plus hasXbrl and seq_id.

name: NSE Emerge - corporate announcements (SME board)
description: Same disclosure schema restricted to the NSE Emerge SME platform, where smaller and less-scrutinised issuers file. Gives sm_name, sm_isin, symbol, filing timestamp, disclosure category and the attachment PDF for each SME filing.

name: NSE India - debt-segment corporate announcements
description: Disclosures by issuers of listed debt (NBFCs, private placements, municipal bonds). Same fields as the equity feed: issuer name, ISIN, timestamp, narrative text and PDF. Surfaces entities with no listed equity that are otherwise invisible in market data.

name: NSE India - InvIT and REIT announcements
description: Disclosure feed for Indian infrastructure investment trusts and real-estate investment trusts (Cube Highways Trust, Nxt-Infra Trust and peers): trust name, ISIN, filing time, category and the underlying document URL. These vehicles hold road, power and property assets and rarely appear in company-registry data.

name: NSE India - mutual fund / ETF announcements
description: AMC-level filings for exchange-traded funds and closed-end schemes: fund house name, scheme symbol, NAV declarations, timestamp and narrative text.

name: NSE India - board meeting intimations (equities)
description: Forward-looking board-meeting calendar: sm_name (company), bm_symbol, sm_isin, bm_date (the meeting date), bm_purpose and bm_desc (what will be considered - results, fund raising, ESOP, capital increase, arrangement schemes), bm_timestamp and the intimation attachment. Advance signal of corporate events before they happen.

name: NSE Emerge - board meeting intimations (SME)
description: Board-meeting calendar for the SME platform: company name, symbol, meeting date, stated purpose and full description of the agenda, plus the filed intimation document.

name: NSE India - corporate actions (equities)
description: Dividends, splits, bonuses, rights and buybacks: comp (company name), isin, symbol, series, faceVal, subject (the action and its rupee terms), exDate, recDate, book-closure and no-delivery windows. Ties a named issuer to a dated cash or equity event.

name: NSE Emerge - corporate actions (SME)
description: Dividend / split / bonus actions on the SME board with company name, ISIN, symbol, face value, ex-date and record date.

name: NSE India - debt corporate actions (interest and redemption)
description: Interest-payment and redemption events on listed debt, including municipal issuers such as Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation: comp (issuer), isin, symbol, faceVal (coupon), subject (Interest Payment / Redemption), recDate and series. Maps bond ISINs to named public and private issuers.

name: NSE India - quarterly financial results filings (equities)
description: 3,816 quarterly-results filings in one response: companyName, isin, symbol, audited/un-audited flag, consolidated vs standalone, financialYear, fromDate/toDate of the period, filingDate, broadCastDate, exchdisstime, indAs format and the XBRL/PDF link. A complete filing-history spine for listed Indian issuers.

name: NSE Emerge - quarterly financial results filings (SME)
description: 680 SME-platform results filings with companyName, ISIN, audit status, consolidation basis, reporting period, filing and dissemination timestamps and the results document.

name: NSE India - credit rating actions
description: 244 credit-rating disclosures: CompanyName (including unlisted borrowers marked NOTLISTED), ISIN, NameOfCRAgency (CRISIL, ICRA, Infomerics, CARE...), CreditRating, RatingAction (Reaffirm / Upgrade / Downgrade), DateofCR and BroadcastDateTime. Links a named borrower to a dated rating action and the agency that issued it.

name: NSE India - open and upcoming IPOs
description: Currently open public issues: companyName, symbol, series, issueStartDate, issueEndDate, issuePrice band, issueSize (shares) and status. Identifies companies raising public money right now.

name: NSE India - bulk and block deals (large trades with counterparty names)
description: High-penetrancy: names the actual counterparty behind each large trade. Per deal: clientName (the buying/selling entity, e.g. ARIHANT CAPITAL MARKETS LIMITED), name (the traded company), symbol, buySell direction, qty, watp (weighted average traded price), date and remarks. This is a named-entity-to-named-entity transaction record.

name: NSE India - daily capital-market report files
description: Directory of the day's official bhavcopy and surveillance report archives: name (report title), type, category, section and a direct link to each CSV/ZIP on nsearchives.nseindia.com. Entry point to the full daily trade and price record.

name: NSE India - all indices snapshot
description: 139 index rows: key (index group), index and indexSymbol, last/open/high/low/previousClose, variation and percentChange, yearHigh/yearLow, pe, pb, dy, advances/declines/unchanged counts and 30d/365d change. Sector-level market state for India.

name: NSE India - trading holiday calendar
description: Official market-closure calendar per segment: tradingDate, weekDay, description (the reason, including one-off closures such as a Maharashtra municipal election) and morning/evening session flags. Useful for dating gaps in any Indian market time series.

name: NSE India - live index option contracts
description: 1,560 live derivative contracts: identifier (unique contract code), underlying, instrumentType, contract, expiryDate, optionType, strikePrice, lastPrice, change, pChange, open/high/low and volume. Contract-level granularity on Indian index derivatives.

name: NITI Aayog - press releases (Drupal JSON:API)
description: Official releases from India's central policy think tank, delivered as JSON:API: stable uuid at the record root plus attributes.title, attributes.created/changed, body and the attached document fields. The only Indian central-government host of ~25 swept with JSON:API left open.

name: NITI Aayog - tender archive
description: Historic NITI Aayog tenders as structured nodes: uuid, attributes.title (tender subject), created and changed dates, and the attached tender document. A procurement trail for a central body whose tenders are otherwise only on CPPP HTML.

name: NITI Aayog - RTI proactive disclosure: foreign visits
description: Section 4(1)(b) RTI proactive disclosure of official foreign travel by NITI Aayog officials: uuid, attributes.title naming the visit, publication dates and the linked disclosure document. Direct official-travel record for named public servants.

name: NITI Aayog - official notifications
description: Formal notifications issued by NITI Aayog with uuid, attributes.title, issue and change timestamps and the notification file.

name: NITI Aayog - what's new feed
description: Rolling notice board of new NITI Aayog items (vacancies, consultations, launches) with uuid, attributes.title, created/changed timestamps and attachment links.

name: NITI Aayog - reports and publications
description: 44 policy reports with uuid, attributes.title, full body text, publication dates and the PDF file reference. Response is ~1.5 MB, i.e. the body text comes down with the record.

name: NITI Aayog - annual reports
description: Annual report series as structured nodes: uuid, attributes.title (year), created/changed dates and the report document link.

name: NITI Aayog - report node collection
description: Separate 'report' content type on the same JSON:API tree: uuid, attributes.title, timestamps and file reference. Small but distinct from reports_and_publication.

name: Pakistan Council of Research in Water Resources - site-wide search
description: Search over Pakistan's national water research body: title, url, id, type/subtype. Reaches groundwater and drinking-water quality monitoring reports, delegation records and technical bulletins.

name: Bhutan Ministry of Finance - site-wide search (WP REST)
description: Search pivot over Bhutan's finance ministry: title, url, id, type/subtype. Hits are dated tender notices (e.g. 'Tender Notice, IFMIS Development Project (10-April-2026)'), budget documents and procurement circulars - effectively Bhutan's central tender feed, since no OCDS endpoint exists.

name: Bhutan Royal Civil Service Commission - site-wide search
description: Search over the body that appoints every Bhutanese civil servant: title, url, id, type/subtype. Reaches vacancy announcements, selection results and transfer/appointment notices naming specific posts and agencies (e.g. Medical Director, Department of Clinical Services).

name: Bhutan Ministry of Health - site-wide search
description: Search over Bhutan's health ministry: title, url, id, type/subtype. Reaches vacancy and cancellation notices, health advisories and programme notifications.

name: Singapore Directory of Professional Engineers with Practising Certificate
description: 2,749 professional engineers. Fields: RegNo, Fullname, Branch, DateofRegistration, Practice_EmployerName, employer type/address, ContactNo. _id id-ish fallback.

name: Singapore List of Suspended & Recently Deregistered Professional Engineers
description: Small but pure-signal disciplinary list: RegNo, Name, Practice_Employer_Name, Practice_Employer_Type, Period_of_Suspension. 3 records at time of probe.

name: Singapore Directory of Course Organisers
description: 724 accredited course organisers. Fields: Organisation_Company, Business_GST_Registration_No, Company_URL, Organisation_Type, Name. GST registration number gives a second identifier to pivot on.

name: Singapore Land Authority - Tender and Bidding Results
description: 589 state-property tender awards. Fields: year, property_location, mode_of_allocation, land_area, gross_floor_area, tendered_uses, tenure, closing_date, award_date, awarded_usage, award_value_per_month_for_the_first_term_tenancy, successful_bidder. Named winning bidder plus award value.

name: Singapore Grant Calls and Awarded Grant Projects (recipient and organisation)
description: 379 awarded research grants. Fields: grant_call, awarded_project, recipient (named principal investigator), organisation. No name-ish key matches exactly, so the label comes from the guaranteed CKAN _id; the intel is in recipient/organisation.

name: Singapore HDB Resale Flat Prices (transaction level)
description: 287,196 individual resale transactions. Fields: month, town, flat_type, block, street_name, storey_range, floor_area_sqm, flat_model, lease_commence_date, resale_price. Address-level property price history; label falls back to the CKAN _id.

name: NZ Charities Services — officers register
description: 583k charity officers with FirstName/MiddleName/LastName/FullName, ContactId, OrganisationId, PositioninOrganisation (Chair, Trustee), appointment and last-day dates, OfficerStatus, and a full disqualification block: BannedDirector, IsNotDisqualified, OfficerProhibitedFromBeingDirector, OfficerUndischargedBankrupt, OfficerBeenConvicted, ConvictedOfAnOffenseRelatingToTerrorism, SubjectToBanningOrder, DisqualifiedByBoard, OfficerSubjectToPropertyOrder.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NZ Charities Services — officer-to-organisation join view
description: The officer record joined to its charity in one row: FullName, OfficerId, ContactId, position, appointment date and disqualification flags PLUS the organisation's Name, CharityRegistrationNumber, NZBNNumber, CharitySummaryURL, WebSiteURL, email and telephone. One request gives you person and entity together — and the NZBN pivots into the NZ business register.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NZ Charities Services — registered charities (extended view)
description: 45,930 registered NZ charities with a literal Name field, OrganisationId, AccountId GUID, CharityRegistrationNumber (CCxxxxx), NZBNNumber, CharitySummaryURL, WebSiteURL, email and phone. Distinct from the base Organisations set: this view carries the NZBN and contact columns.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NZ Charities Services — annual financial returns
description: 421k charity annual returns with roughly 90 financial columns per row: OrganisationId, GroupId, AsAtDate, YearEnded, Status, all current and non-current liabilities, cash and bank balances, investments, land and buildings, GovtGrantsContracts, GrantsPaidWithinNZ and GrantsPaidOutsideNZ, SalariesAndWages, employee counts and volunteer hours. NOTE: no name field — the label is AnnualReturnId, or the AsAtDate + numeric fallback.

name: Hong Kong LegCo — voting results database
description: 541,840 individual division records from the Legislative Council: id, start_date, committee type, term_no, vote_number, vote_date, vote_time, the motion text in Chinese and English, and the member-level vote. Shows exactly how each HK legislator voted on each motion.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Hong Kong LegCo — bills database
description: Every bill put before LegCo: internal_key, ordinance_title_eng and _chi, bill_title_eng and _chi, and ordinance_content_url_eng/_chi linking straight to the consolidated text on elegislation.gov.hk. The legislative history behind any HK ordinance.

name: Hong Kong LegCo — Hansard speeches
description: 550,841 individual speeches from the LegCo record: RundownID, HansardID, MeetingDate, HansardType (English/Chinese), SectionID and SectionName, SpeakerID, SpeakerName and the full Speeches text. Every attributable utterance by a named HK legislator or official since 2001.

name: World Bank — IBRD statement of loans and guarantees
description: 9,513 IBRD loans: loan_number, country, named borrower entity (e.g. MINISTRY OF FINANCE), guarantor, loan type and status, interest rate, project_id and project_name, original principal, cancelled, undisbursed, disbursed, repaid, due, borrower's obligation, first/last repayment dates, agreement signing and board approval dates. 10.4 MB. Labels on region because region precedes country in the title precedence — country, borrower and project_name are all in props.

name: African Development Bank — MapAfrica results indicators
description: The 35 AfDB results indicators (people with access to better health services, etc.) with slug id and full name — the codelist behind the MapAfrica project portal. The project/activity endpoint on the same host needs a real AfDB activity id and Cloudflare began challenging before I could verify one, so only this verified endpoint is returned.
